text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business which asks for staff to report on the feasibility of installing a traffic light in the vicinity of the driveways of the large condominium complexes at 68 Corporate Drive and 88 Corporate Drive. As you may know, Corporate Drive is a very busy street that many drivers, cyclists, TTC riders, and pedestrians use to access the Scarborough Town Centre, Lee Centre and Corporate Drive condominium towers and Lee Centre Park on a daily basis. Population density, TTC ridership and general activity in the area has significantly expanded in recent years and has increased traffic in this area. I have received several complaints from members of the community regarding speeding in the area that presents a major safety concern to the community and a danger to local residents who must run across six lanes of traffic to get to and from…

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to report to the July 4, 2018 meeting of Scarborough Community Council on the feasibility of installing a traffic light in the vicinity of the driveways of the large condominium complexes at 68 Corporate Drive and 88 Corporate Drive.
